add_guests.description: Adds one or more guests directly to an event (default status "Going", one ticket of the default type unless overridden) and returns an empty response on success.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: guests
params.description: Guests to add, each requiring at least email; existing names are not overwritten. Each guest may include registration_answers (question_id + value) for the event's registration questions.

params.name: ticket
params.description: Assign a single ticket of the specified event_ticket_type_id to each guest. Cannot be combined with tickets.

params.name: tickets
params.description: Assign multiple tickets (each by event_ticket_type_id) to each guest. Cannot be combined with ticket.

params.name: approval_status
params.description: Status to assign each added guest: approved, pending_approval, or waitlist. Defaults to approved.

params.name: send_email
params.description: Whether Luma should email each added guest. Defaults to true.

cancel_event.description: Cancels an event using a cancellation token from request_event_cancellation — irreversible, deletes the event, notifies all guests, and processes refunds if requested — and returns an empty response on success.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: cancellation_token
params.description: The cancellation token returned by request_event_cancellation.

params.name: should_refund
params.description: Whether to refund paid guests. Conditionally required — must be set if the event has paid guests (see is_paid from request_event_cancellation).

create_coupon.description: Creates a new discount coupon for an event and returns the created coupon.

params.name: code
params.description: Code the guest enters on the event page. Case-insensitive, maximum 20 characters.

params.name: remaining_count
params.description: Number of times the coupon can be used. Set to 1000000 for unlimited uses.

params.name: valid_start_at
params.description: ISO 8601 datetime the coupon becomes valid.

params.name: valid_end_at
params.description: ISO 8601 datetime the coupon expires.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discriminated union: {discount_type: "percent", percent_off} (0-100), or {discount_type: "amount", cents_off, currency}.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: event_ticket_type_id
params.description: Restrict the coupon to a single ticket type. If that ticket type is hidden, the coupon acts as an unlock/access code instead of a discount.

create_event.description: Creates a new event and returns its id.

params.name: can_register_for_multiple_tickets
params.description: Whether a single guest can register for multiple tickets.

params.name: cover_url
params.description: Cover image URL; must be hosted on the Luma CDN (images.lumacdn.com), uploaded via /v1/images/create-upload-url first.

params.name: coordinate
params.description: {longitude, latitude} for the event location.

params.name: description_md
params.description: Markdown description, converted internally to Luma's rich text format; embedded images must be hosted on the Luma CDN.

params.name: end_at
params.description: ISO 8601 datetime the event ends.

params.name: geo_address_json
params.description: Either {type: "manual", address} for a free-text address, or {type: "google", place_id, description?} for a Google Maps Place ID.

params.name: location_visibility
params.description: public (default) or guests-only — hides the precise location from unapproved guests.

params.name: max_capacity
params.description: Maximum registrations before the event is marked sold out (or guests join the waitlist, if enabled).

params.name: meeting_url
params.description: Virtual meeting URL for online events.

params.name: name
params.description: Event name.

params.name: name_requirement
params.description: full-name or first-last — whether to split the guest name field into first/last.

params.name: phone_number_requirement
params.description: optional or required — whether guests must supply a phone number at registration; omit to not collect it.

params.name: registration_open
params.description: Whether to accept registrations. Defaults to true.

params.name: registration_questions
params.description: Custom registration questions; each object is discriminated by question_type (agree-check, company, dropdown, github, instagram, linkedin, long-text, multi-select, phone-number, telegram, text, twitter, url, youtube, terms).

params.name: reminders_disabled
params.description: Turns off Luma's default pre-event reminder emails.

params.name: feedback_email
params.description: {enabled, delay} settings for the post-event feedback email; delay defaults to PT0M, maximum P7D.

params.name: show_guest_list
params.description: Whether approved guests can see who else is attending.

params.name: slug
params.description: URL slug for the event page (luma.com/<slug>); creation fails if unavailable.

params.name: start_at
params.description: ISO 8601 datetime the event starts.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York.

params.name: tint_color
params.description: Hex color, e.g. #bb2dc7; alpha channels are stripped.

params.name: visibility
params.description: public, members-only, or private.

params.name: waitlist_status
params.description: disabled or enabled — whether new registrations join a waitlist once capacity is reached.

create_ticket_type.description: Creates a new ticket type for an event and returns the created ticket type, including its id.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: name
params.description: Ticket type name.

params.name: require_approval
params.description: Whether registrations for this ticket type require host approval.

params.name: is_hidden
params.description: Hides the ticket type from public view, e.g. for an invite-only tier.

params.name: description
params.description: Ticket type description.

params.name: valid_start_at
params.description: ISO 8601 date the ticket type becomes available.

params.name: valid_end_at
params.description: ISO 8601 date the ticket type stops being available.

params.name: max_capacity
params.description: Maximum number of this ticket type that can be issued.

params.name: type
params.description: free or paid.

params.name: cents
params.description: Ticket price as an integer in the smallest unit of currency (e.g. cents for USD); only meaningful when type is paid.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code for cents.

params.name: is_flexible
params.description: Enables "pay what you want" pricing for a paid ticket.

params.name: min_cents
params.description: Minimum amount a guest may pay when is_flexible is true.

get_event.description: Retrieves the full details of a single event you have manage access for, including hosts and a breakdown of guest counts by status.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

get_guest.description: Retrieves the details of a single guest for an event, including ticket order details.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: id
params.description: Guest identifier — the guest ID (gst-), a ticket key, a guest key (g-), or the user's email.

get_ticket_type.description: Retrieves the details of a single ticket type.

params.name: event_ticket_type_id
params.description: Ticket type ID, this usually starts with ttype-.

list_event_coupons.description: Returns a paginated list of coupons associated with an event.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: pagination_cursor
params.description: Value of next_cursor from a previous request.

params.name: pagination_limit
params.description: The number of items to return. The server enforces a maximum.

list_guests.description: Returns a paginated list of guests who have registered or been invited to an event, including guest summaries and event_tickets (use get_guest for order-level detail).

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: approval_status
params.description: Filter by status: approved, session, pending_approval, invited, declined, or waitlist.

params.name: pagination_cursor
params.description: Value of next_cursor from a previous request.

params.name: pagination_limit
params.description: The number of items to return. The server enforces a maximum.

params.name: sort_column
params.description: name, email, created_at, registered_at, or checked_in_at.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: asc, desc, asc nulls last, or desc nulls last.

list_ticket_types.description: Returns the full list of ticket types for an event in one response (not paginated).

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: include_hidden
params.description: Include hidden ticket types in the results.

request_event_cancellation.description: Requests a short-lived cancellation token and impact preview (guest count, whether paid) for an event — the first step of Luma's two-step cancellation flow.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

send_invites.description: Sends one or more guests a soft invite to an event by email (and SMS if their phone is linked to their Luma account) that they can accept, returning an empty response on success.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: guests
params.description: Guests to invite, each requiring at least email; existing names are not overwritten.

params.name: message
params.description: Personalized message included in the invite. Maximum 200 characters.

update_guest_status.description: Updates a guest's status (approved, declined, pending_approval, or waitlist), optionally refunding them and/or emailing a personal message, and returns an empty response on success.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: guest_id
params.description: Guest identifier — the guest ID (gst-), a ticket key, a guest key (g-), or the user's email.

params.name: status
params.description: approved, declined, pending_approval, or waitlist.

params.name: should_refund
params.description: If moving a paid guest to declined, waitlist, or pending_approval, whether to refund their payment. Defaults to false.

params.name: send_email
params.description: Whether Luma should email the guest about the status change. Defaults to true.

params.name: message
params.description: Personal message included in the status-change email. Maximum 200 characters. Can't be combined with send_email: false.

update_guest_tickets.description: Administratively adds complimentary tickets to or removes/invalidates tickets from an existing guest with no payment or refund processed, returning an empty response on success.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event ID, this usually starts with evt-.

params.name: guest_id
params.description: Guest identifier — the guest ID (gst-), a ticket key, a guest key (g-), or the user's email.

params.name: ticket_ids_to_remove
params.description: Existing ticket IDs to invalidate. Removing tickets does not issue a refund, and at least one valid ticket must remain on the guest. Default [].

params.name: tickets_to_add
params.description: Complimentary tickets to grant (each by event_ticket_type_id); each entry creates a new $0 administrative ticket even for a normally paid ticket type. Default [].

params.name: send_email
params.description: Whether Luma may email the guest about the ticket change. Defaults to true and still respects notification preferences.

update_ticket_type.description: Updates an existing ticket type's details and returns the updated ticket type.
